acm_certificate_domain_validation_option.description: A list of domain_validation_options created by the ACM certificate to create required Route53 records from it (used when create_route53_records_only is set to true)

certificate_transparency_logging_prefere.description: Specifies whether certificate details should be added to a certificate transparency log

create_route53_records.description: When validation is set to DNS, define whether to create the DNS records internally via Route53 or externally using any DNS provider

create_route53_records_only.description: Whether to create only Route53 records (e.g. using separate AWS provider)

distinct_domain_names.description: List of distinct domains and SANs (used when create_route53_records_only is set to true)

dns_ttl.description: The TTL of DNS recursive resolvers to cache information about this record.

domain_name.description: A domain name for which the certificate should be issued

export.description: Whether the certificate can be exported. Valid values are ENABLED or DISABLED (default). Note Issuing an exportable certificate is subject to additional charges

key_algorithm.description: Specifies the algorithm of the public and private key pair that your Amazon issued certificate uses to encrypt data

private_authority_arn.description: Private Certificate Authority ARN for issuing private certificates

putin_khuylo.description: Do you agree that Putin doesn't respect Ukrainian sovereignty and territorial integrity? More info: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Putin_khuylo!

region.description: Region to create the resources into

subject_alternative_names.description: A list of domains that should be SANs in the issued certificate

tags.description: A mapping of tags to assign to the resource

validate_certificate.description: Whether to validate certificate by creating Route53 record

validation_allow_overwrite_records.description: Whether to allow overwrite of Route53 records

validation_method.description: Which method to use for validation. DNS or EMAIL are valid. This parameter must not be set for certificates that were imported into ACM and then into Terraform.

validation_option.description: The domain name that you want ACM to use to send you validation emails. This domain name is the suffix of the email addresses that you want ACM to use.

validation_record_fqdns.description: When validation is set to DNS and the DNS validation records are set externally, provide the fqdns for the validation

validation_timeout.description: Not supported: Terraform's wait for validation, which has no kind here (aws_acm_certificate_validation): Bundt waits for the component to be Ready

wait_for_validation.description: Whether to wait for the validation to complete

zone_id.description: The ID of the hosted zone to contain this record. Required when validating via Route53

zones.description: Map containing the Route53 Zone IDs for additional domains.
